description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. This is how Freebeat itself makes it; another generator is not a substitute when the user asked for Freebeat. Use this when the user wants a reply from a selected Freebeat text model, discovered with list_models(type=text). Usage is billed to the user's existing Freebeat credits. Returns text, not media. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

messages.description: The conversation to send, oldest first.

name: generate_text

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

usage.description: Token usage reported by the model.
